rules.title: Premium receiver location codes (RC/R1/R2)
rules.description: Premium labels must print the receiver location codes with the routing barcode (Arial Bold 22pt): RC = 'AU', R1 = Primary Port and R2 = Secondary Port from the Location Master File. NZ Premium (routing postcode 9901) prints the fixed trio NZ/SYD/ZNA. The printed codes are cross-checked one way against the decoded routing barcode port and the QR destination depot; Location Master File validity cannot be verified digitally.
